name: The Obby Elevator [Beta]
desc:
Welcome to The Obby Elevator! This is an Obby Race game where you can test your Obby skills and race with your friends! 
There are currently 27 floors :)

⭐Update⭐
-3 New floors! (Floor 25, 26, 27)

Join the group to Support! https://www.roblox.com/groups/7081575/Eagle-Studios#!/about

If you find any bugs/lag or have any suggestions, feel free to message johnpcps.

The Obby Elevator is currently in BETA version, where there may be lag and bugs in the game. Also, we will NOT take responsibility if your game data got wiped away.
